result.summary: The image shows an urban intersection with standard pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks, traffic signals, and marked crosswalks. However, large vehicles create significant visual obstructions, and the wide roadway lacks mid-crossing refuges.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: The school bus and foreground vehicle significantly block sightlines between drivers and pedestrians at the intersection.

hazards.name: Wide Crossing
hazards.description: The roadway width increases exposure time for pedestrians without a refuge island.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Implement curb extensions or 'no parking' zones near the intersection to improve visibility.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a median refuge to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before vehicles get a green light.

result.summary: The image shows a wide urban intersection with high-visibility continental crosswalks and sidewalks on both sides. While basic infrastructure like traffic signals and curb ramps are present, the multi-lane roadway creates a significant crossing distance for pedestrians without a refuge island.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross four lanes of traffic without a refuge island, increasing exposure time to vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway at the marked crosswalk.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Parked cars along the curb can block the view between drivers and pedestrians entering the crosswalk.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image along the curb line near the intersection.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers by moving the waiting area forward.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Add a median refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross the wide street in two stages, reducing total exposure time.

result.summary: The environment features a wide multi-lane roadway with high-visibility zebra crosswalks and a raised median refuge. However, the presence of embedded streetcar tracks and a lack of visible dedicated pedestrian signals increase the complexity and risk for people crossing.

hazards.name: Embedded Rail Tracks
hazards.description: Streetcar tracks in the center of the roadway present a tripping hazard for pedestrians and a significant slip/entrapment risk for cyclists.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the roadway, running parallel to traffic lanes

hazards.name: Wide Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The multi-lane configuration increases the time pedestrians are exposed to vehicle traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the entire width of the foreground roadway

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: The asphalt surrounding the tracks is cracked and uneven, increasing the risk of trips within the crosswalk.
hazards.location_in_image: Intersection of the crosswalk and the rail tracks

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear information on remaining crossing time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulbout)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pavement Maintenance
interventions.description: Repair the degraded asphalt around the rail tracks to ensure a level walking surface within the crosswalk.

result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility zebra crosswalks and pedestrian signals, providing basic infrastructure for walkers. However, the wide multi-lane roadway creates a long crossing distance without a refuge island, increasing exposure to traffic.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic in a single stage without a mid-street refuge island.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main roadway.

hazards.name: Multi-lane Threat
hazards.description: The wide roadway allows for multiple lanes of traffic in the same direction, which can lead to visibility issues if one vehicle stops and another does not.
